decisions.title: Which source wins when both config.json projects and a Saved_Config exist?
options: config.json projects key wins; Saved_Config is ignored
decisions.recommended: config.json projects key wins; Saved_Config is ignored
decisions.answer: Saved_Config wins once it exists; config.json projects is the fallback when setup.json is absent

decisions.title: Should the repository path be further restricted (e.g. to home directory or known paths)?
options: No restriction beyond existing git checkout check
Restrict to paths under the user's home directory
decisions.recommended: No restriction beyond existing git checkout check
decisions.answer: No restriction beyond existing git checkout check
